metadata.question: On August 6, 2024 at 1:40 pm local time, were land surface temperatures along the Paris Olympic marathon starting line (Hôtel de Ville) lower than in the Fausses-Reposes forest near Versailles?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need land surface temperature data for August 6, 2024 at ~1:40 PM local time - Paris is in UTC+2 during summer (CEST), so 1:40 PM = 11:40 UTC - MODIS LST products (MOD11A1/MYD11A1) have overpass times around 10:30 AM and 1:30 PM local time - Landsat 8/9 has 16-day revisit, might not have data on this exact date - Use MODIS Terra (MOD11A1) or Aqua (MYD11A1) for day LST - Two locations: Hôtel de Ville (Paris city center ~48.856°N, 2.352°E) and Fausses-Reposes forest (~48.815°N, 2.175°E) 2. Masking strategy: - Use QC bands to filter good quality LST pixels - No cloud masking needed for LST (already processed) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - LST values should be in reasonable range (e.g., 280-330K or 7-57°C) - Check if both locations have valid data - Compare: if Hôtel de Ville LST < Fausses-Reposes LST → A (Yes), else → B (No) - Handle C1 (no images), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (invalid values) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const hotelDeVille = ee.Geometry.Point([2.352, 48.856]); const faussesReposes = ee.Geometry.Point([2.175, 48.815]); const targetDate = '2024-08-06'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Try MODIS Aqua (MYD11A1) for daytime LST around 1:30 PM local let aquaCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD11A1') .filterDate(targetDate, '2024-08-07') .select('LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day'); let aquaSize = await aquaCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Aqua images on ${targetDate}: ${aquaSize}`); // Fallback to Terra if Aqua has no data if (aquaSize === 0) { console.log('Trying MODIS Terra (MOD11A1)...'); aquaCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .filterDate(targetDate, '2024-08-07') .select('LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day'); aquaSize = await aquaCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Terra images on ${targetDate}: ${aquaSize}`); } if (aquaSize === 0) { console.log('No MODIS data available for this date.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Get LST image and apply QC filter const lstImg = aquaCol.first(); // QC filter: keep only good quality pixels (bits 0-1 = 00) const qcMask = lstImg.select('QC_Day').bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0); const lstMasked = lstImg.select('LST_Day_1km').updateMask(qcMask).multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15); // 4. Extract LST values at both locations const hotelStats = await lstMasked.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: hotelDeVille, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const forestStats = await lstMasked.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: faussesReposes, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const hotelLST = hotelStats.LST_Day_1km; const forestLST = forestStats.LST_Day_1km; console.log(`Hotel de Ville LST: ${hotelLST !== null ? hotelLST.toFixed(2) + '°C' : 'null'}`); console.log(`Fausses-Reposes Forest LST: ${forestLST !== null ? forestLST.toFixed(2) + '°C' : 'null'}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (hotelLST === null || forestLST === null) { console.log('No valid pixels at one or both locations.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (hotelLST < -50 || hotelLST > 70 || forestLST < -50 || forestLST > 70) { console.log('Invalid LST values detected.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (hotelLST < forestLST) { console.log('Hotel de Ville was cooler than Fausses-Reposes forest.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Hotel de Ville was NOT cooler than Fausses-Reposes forest.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
